verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a GPU→CPU fallback path exists (M1/M2 falls back to llama.cpp engine per runanywhere-comm-13, NPU/Hexagon acceleration mentioned in docs-17/34) but nowhere shows diagnostic output, logs, or error messages that tell a power-user *why* GPU acceleration failed or silently fell back. No console/log excerpt, error code, or debug flag is documented for this scenario.
